scope: Real public SMS text observations in a controlled regenerative latent process; not natural chronological SMS dynamics or production readiness.
gain_test: two-sided exact paired sign flips over eight fit seed means, Holm over two primary domains
noninferiority_test: simultaneous one-sided t lower bound (alpha/2 per domain) on eight paired fit seed means
cost_test: ratio of total measured CPU per episode, including unique full-process fit/preparation/calibration, frontend and actual read/encode/native work; quality bound must also pass
model_search_cost: all three candidate fits and selection cost disclosed separately, shared model search cannot be silently omitted; deployment unique and equal-calibration-charge sensitivities also reported
tie_rule: lowest finite action within tolerance using exact subtraction correction; same rule at every Bellman node and content classification

dataset.name: UCI SMS Spam Collection
dataset.normalization: NFKC + whitespace collapse + casefold for dedup/split identity; original text for encoding
dataset.conflicting_duplicates: remove all identities with multiple labels
dataset.shared_frontend: HashingVectorizer word 1..2 grams, 2^14 dimensions, alternate_sign=False, L2; LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=300 random_state=130001, trained only encoder_train
dataset.smoothing: training empirical categorical counts + 0.5 per bin; actual corpus sampling uses no invented messages
dataset.visible_information: all actors receive same six-bin encoded text evidence, unavailable token, observed mask and dt; full shared calibrated Q/likelihood/payoff given to all value controllers
dataset.class_prior: controlled process initially balanced; not natural SMS class proportions
dataset.confirmation_read_policy: materialize and encode raw confirmation text only at actual READ; unseen data never enter fit or model selection
dataset.estimand: conditional on the deduplicated fixed corpus; seed independence concerns training and controlled trajectories, not an independent corpus sample

ordinary_selection: minimum validation posterior CE between GRU64 and gated continuous diagonal SSM64; choice frozen per seed
structural_reference: generic Bayes/HMM with identical calibrated Q, prior, emissions and controller; mathematical equivalence is an expected null, not a success target
production_gate: No default activation; evidence must separately establish quality, cost, supported precision, discretization scope, actual device and workload.
confirmation_freeze: source, native binary, all fitted weights, frontend and chosen ordinary cores hashed before encoding or evaluating confirmation split; outcomes append-only
allowed_development: training/validation partitions and dedicated development seed only; failures retained; no retuning after confirmation
